scope: New synthetic offline tests only; no historical replay, backend, Skill or native-model execution by this audit.

Ambiguous/malformed block, instruction, edge or result identity
Binary dispatch or required topology change
True missing endpoint mixed with dependency correction
Missing actual producer or inconsistent carry predecessors
